Il y a 50 ans, un seul salaire faisait vivre une famille, les bistrots remplissaient chaque village et les objets duraient toute une vie. Qu'est-ce qui a changé ?

Sur Ce Que la France a Perdu, nous ouvrons les archives de la France d'avant : comment nos grands-parents vivaient sans frigo ni chauffage central, pourquoi les grands magasins et les usines ont disparu, et comment l'argent, les impôts et la retraite ont transformé la vie des Français.

As researchers like Dr. Stephen Krashen have shown over the past 40+ years, receiving comprehensible input, that is, messages that you can understand in the target language, is what actually results in language acquisition.

Learn German the natural & fun way!

In the classroom we are told to endlessly study grammar and memorise concepts, however, research shows that language is acquired through authentic experiences. The concept of Natürlich German is based on Dr. Stephen Krashen's second language acquisition theory, in which one uses comprehensible input to acquire a language, rather than 'learn' it.
